description: This file provides utility functions for file operations such as reading properties from files, reading file contents, checking if a path is a regular file, recursive file searching, and property expansion within strings. It is part of a namespace Utils and is used for various helper functionalities in a larger project.

methods.name: bool readPropertyFromFile(const char * filename,const string & property,string & propertyValue)
methods.description: Reads a property value from a specified file, supporting recursive expansion of values starting with '$'.

methods.name: bool readFileContent(const char * filename,string & content)
methods.description: Reads the entire content of a specified file into a string.

methods.name: bool isRegularFile(const string & path)
methods.description: Checks whether a given filesystem path is a regular file.

methods.name: bool searchFilesRec(std::vector<std::string> & pathList,unsigned int currentDepth,const std::list<string> & exclusions,string & result)
methods.description: Helper function that recursively searches for files matching patterns within directories, with support for exclusions and result capping.

methods.name: bool searchFiles(string & inputPath,int maxDepth,int minDepth,const std::list<string> & exclusions,string & result)
methods.description: Starts a recursive search for files matching patterns from an input directory, with configurable depth constraints.

methods.name: bool ExpandPropertiesInString(const char * input,const char * filePath,string & expandedString)
methods.description: Processes a string to replace variable placeholders with values from a property file, supporting variable expansion.
